key_metric: Sequential direction of RPO from $638bn (does the backlog still grow after ~$19bn of revenue recognition and no announced megadeal since 10 June), read alongside whether FY27 capex is reaffirmed at ~$70bn net / $90-95bn gross or raised, and whether OCI accelerates from +93% toward the ~+116% the 58-64% cloud guide implies
coverage_gaps: Current options skew (25-delta risk reversal) unavailable - MarketChameleon and OptionCharts paywalled; cannot tell whether the 11.5% straddle is priced symmetrically
Current-week unusual options activity unavailable - only UOA article found is from September 2025 (spot $302) and is stale

Individual one-day earnings moves sourced for only 5 of the last 16 quarters; mean/median abs are therefore n=5 and badly skewed by the +35.95% Sep-2025 outlier (ex-outlier mean 10.46%). The 16-quarter aggregate (7/16 up, avg +/-9.7%, worst -13.5%, best +35.9%) is sourced and is the better base rate
60-day and 90-day estimate revision series unavailable; only 30-day sourced (+0.5% EPS, +0.2% FY27, +0.3% FY28)
No credibly published whisper number; TD Cowen's +116% OCI model used as a single-broker proxy for the buy-side bar
No published Street consensus estimate for Q1 FY27 RPO - this is the metric I argue the print trades on and it is the largest single hole
FY2026 10-K risk-factor text on OpenAI customer concentration not retrieved; the ~50%+ of backlog figure is S&P's and BofA's estimate, not Oracle's disclosure
Irreconcilable realised-move statistics between SpotGamma (8-quarter average 5.1%) and Earnings Watcher (16-report average +/-9.7%); unresolved and it changes whether the straddle is rich or fair
Fed hike odds (~60% for the 15-16 Sep FOMC) sourced only to a secondary aggregator, not CME FedWatch or a tier-1 outlet; the macro paragraph is weaker than the rest of the dossier as a result
No Google Trends, web traffic, app rank or review alt-data sourceable for an enterprise infrastructure vendor
No timestamped 2026-09-10 intraday or pre-market quote; spot anchor is the 2026-09-09 close and is one session stale as of the print
